- `rg -n "Aboriginal Studies 30|Units|Film Room|Theme 1 Questions|Library|Assignments|Quizzes|activity-response|film-room|sidebar|progress" projects/aboriginal-studies-30/workspace/index.html projects/aboriginal-studies-30/workspace/main.js projects/aboriginal-studies-30/workspace/styles.css projects/aboriginal-studies-30/workspace/course-data.js`
  - exitCode: 0.
- Read `projects/aboriginal-studies-30/meta/project.json`.

- `rg -n "Brightspace|Source file|Converted from|Phases|Performance|View Chapter|Download PDF|Theme 1 Questions|Film Room" projects/aboriginal-studies-30/meta/google-stitch-redesign-brief.md`
  - exitCode: 0.
- `Get-Content -Raw projects/aboriginal-studies-30/meta/google-stitch-redesign-brief.md | Measure-Object -Line -Word -Character`
  - exitCode: 0.

Command output summary with exit codes:
- STAX/context reads: exit 0.
- Workspace/design context search: exit 0.
- Project metadata read and meta listing: exit 0.
- Design brief read-back: exit 0.
- Brief content check: exit 0; confirmed required target terms and constraints are present.
- Brief size check: exit 0; 310 lines, 1385 words.

What is verified:
- The Markdown brief exists at `projects/aboriginal-studies-30/meta/google-stitch-redesign-brief.md`.
- It asks Stitch to redesign the Aboriginal Studies 30 course shell while preserving Units, Quizzes, Assignments, Library, and Film Room.
- It includes the required Theme 1 Questions, Library, PDF viewer, Assignment, and Film Room requirements.
- It explicitly says not to include Phases or Performance.
- It includes student-facing wording rules and cultural/visual constraints to avoid generic or inappropriate decoration.

What is weak/provisional:
- No Google Stitch import/render was performed in this repo.
- The brief is a design prompt, not an implemented redesign.

What is unverified:
- Whether Stitch will follow every constraint exactly.
- Whether any Stitch output will be directly implementable without cleanup.

Risks:
- Stitch may still introduce unwanted marketing sections, decorative imagery, or generic layout patterns; review output against the acceptance criteria in the brief.
- If Stitch returns code, it should be integrated through the project generator/source path rather than directly patching generated workspace output.

One next action:
Send `projects/aboriginal-studies-30/meta/google-stitch-redesign-brief.md` to Google Stitch, then bring back the result for integration into the Aboriginal Studies 30 generator.
